column7: God never takes you down! He will never run you down; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He is speaking from the frame of reference that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and ACCEPTED by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you **GREAT AND MIGHTY** things which you do not know.” Does that sound like running you down or doom and gloom? There is NO doom and gloom in God, therefore He cannot tell you anything doomy or gloomy. You’ll have to tune in to the world’s news agency for doom and gloom.
column8: God never takes you down! He never condemns you; He only lifts you up and strengthens you. When God speaks to you, He speaks from the perspective that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and accepted by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and mighty things which you do not know.” Does that sound like putting you down or like darkness and despair? There is no darkness or despair in God, therefore He can never tell you such dark or gloomy things. For darkness and despair you will have to stick with the world’s news agencies.
